dict.string: Lets Personal Agent in DSH read your calendar and add events after you confirm. 让 DSH 中的 Personal Agent 查看日程，并在你确认后新建日程。
Lets Personal Agent in DSH read your reminders, add reminders and mark them done. 让 DSH 中的 Personal Agent 查看、新建提醒事项并把提醒标记为完成。
Lets Personal Agent in DSH search, read and create notes, and read mail and save drafts in Mail. 让 DSH 中的 Personal Agent 搜索、阅读和新建备忘录，阅读邮件并存草稿。
